name: claude-config
description: Four audit skills for a repo's Claude Code configuration: audit (settings.json / .mcp.json / hooks / plugins / permissions drift), audit-automation-gaps (evidence-gated verdicts on automation gaps), audit-permission-grants (allow-rule / allowed-tools grants for auto-mode durability and portability), and audit-instructions (locally-owned instruction surfaces vs current model capability — proposes removals/rewrites of instructions the model no longer needs, and detects cross-surface instruction conflicts).
